newsitem.title: USA: Gulfstream wins $68.9 mln US Air Force deal.
newsitem.headline: Gulfstream wins $68.9 mln US Air Force deal.

text.p: Gulfstream Aerospace Corp said it won a $68.9 initial contract to build two Gulfstream V aircraft for the U.S. Air Force for a program to expand the mission capability of the U.S. Special Air Mission Wing.
The company said the contract has options for up to four additional jets before 2003, which would bring the total value of to over $275 million. The aircraft are designated C-37A.
The jets will be assigned to part of an Air Force command that provides air transportation services for the President of the United States and other national leaders.
Gulfstream will provide technical and logistic support, spare parts and overhaul services to the Air Force for 10 years, it said.
